svg.title: Last-Metre Eyes: relay chain from drone to incident command
svg.desc: A drone surveys inside a damaged structure and builds an occupancy map. A 42 kB map packet goes over a modelled Wi-Fi HaLow link to a perimeter relay, over Viasat L-band (a mock in the demo) to incident command, which makes a go, no-go or cleared entry decision. Solid lines are real work, dashed lines modelled, dotted lines a mock.
